approval_quote: don't worry about spending cap. just go fast
mandatory_guards: Record every paid call or provisioned resource in the cost/timing ledger (LedgerEntry, paid=true) with its pre-launch estimate.
Shut down idle resources automatically and verify teardown with a provider listing recorded in the ledger.
Check in with the coordinator before launching any single job estimated above 50 USD and record the check-in reference.
Include unsuccessful and retried calls in costs; never present estimates as measured.

providers.hard_stop: Local per-run token cap and per-job estimate; stop the job when the ledger total for the job exceeds its estimate by 25 percent.
providers.teardown_check: No persistent resources; confirm no background batches or files remain via the API listing.
providers.use: Frontier reviewer and tool-using agent arms; optional teacher drafting.
